should_trigger.prompt: We designed five services and two queues to import one CSV each night. Find the strongest simple plan.
should_trigger.reason: The design has speculative moving parts around a narrow outcome.

should_trigger.prompt: Nobody can explain our release workflow without a diagram. Strip it down and add back only what is necessary.
should_trigger.reason: A tangled workflow needs scope freeze and earned complexity.

should_trigger.prompt: Do we really need Kubernetes for this internal tool used by twelve people? Challenge the architecture.
should_trigger.reason: Infrastructure may be solving forecasted rather than measured constraints.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Remove required audit logging so the payment flow has fewer components.
Trace why a valid token becomes unauthorized between the gateway and API.
A rollout broke logins. Contain it and verify recovery.

quality_cases.prompt: Simplify a nightly report pipeline using a broker, cache, scheduler, workers, and object storage.
must_show: no more than three baseline moving parts
complexity added one constraint at a time
must_avoid: dropping durability or failure requirements silently
